purpose: confirm by hands-on exploration that each feature does what the requirements say, including the cases nobody scripted
entry_criteria: Build is deployed in a test environment
Requirements and acceptance criteria are available
procedure: Write test cases from each acceptance criterion with the steps, data and expected result.
Add cases from boundaries and rules: smallest and largest values, empty input, invalid combinations and permission differences.
Execute the cases, recording actual results with evidence for each failure: steps, data, screenshots and the build.
Spend a time-boxed session exploring beyond the scripts, following what looks odd, and record what was covered.
Report defects with clear steps and severity, and retest fixes against the original steps.
Summarize coverage of the criteria and the open defects.
acceptance_criteria: Every acceptance criterion has a case and a result
Failures have reproducible steps and evidence

validation.check: count acceptance criteria and test cases that reference them
validation.expect: every criterion has at least one case

validation.check: take three defect reports and reproduce them from the steps alone

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Testing a discount feature from its criteria finds a correct result for a single code, then exploration with two codes applied in different order shows a different total; the defect is reported with the exact order and amounts.
